payload.concept: Future Branch should prepare what follows both failure and success, while accumulated validated findings change each next choice, test and repair. Storing logs alone is not reuse.
extension: Owner reuse: after pass, test durable-state integration through the same ingress; after fail, diagnose accepted-source dependencies without a substitute owner.
Restart holds: after pass, test trusted recovery without erased evidence or spend; after fail, isolate both outcome-state loss and quarantine identity loss.
Gate serialization: after pass, test queued expiry and distinguish confirmed versus unresolved lost replies; after fail, repair the actual supported ingress bypass instead of adding locks.
Durable spend: after pass, test only contract-permitted zero-effect refunds versus uncertain spend; after fail, inspect both grant overwrite and reconstruction loss.
payload.reuse: Every second step records the earlier static finding that changes it, source provenance, invalidating evidence, a prewritten test/response and acceptance criteria. Unused branches remain available; contradicted ones are marked invalid rather than silently reused.
payload.bounds: Four branches extended one level only. The original eight cards remain unchanged. No newer implementation was observed before preparation. Candidate corrections/tests are hypotheses, not observed new defects, model training or measured efficiency.
payload.handoff: The source-referenced extension is available in the verified private repository. Use it with the existing correction handoff; no extra acknowledgment or broad design round is needed.
payload.authority: Planning only; no execution, listener, install, access change, deployment or live input.
